show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Patrick O’Shaughnessy - Creating on Principle - [Invest Like the Best, EP.455]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Only David Senra could get me to be on the other side of the mic.
reader_summary.overview: Only David Senra could get me to be on the other side of the mic. Because I don’t plan on being interviewed often, I wanted to share this conversation, which I so enjoyed, with our audience. It went in a very different direction than I expected.

key_points.text: We barely talk about investing or interviewing.
Instead, we talk about finding an organizing principle for life, undiscovered talent.
This conversation was originally recorded and released on David Senra, and I wanted to share on the Invest Like The Best feed as well.
